name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Interim Agreement on Trade between the European Union and the United Mexican States
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should sign a trade agreement with Mexico. This is an interim deal, a first step before a wider partnership agreement. Parliament's consent is needed before it can take effect. The deal covers trade in goods and services between the two sides. A majority of the trade committee backed it, while a minority warned it could let companies sue governments and push factories to move to Mexico.

- The European Union can now formally conclude its interim trade agreement with Mexico.
- It affects exporters, farmers, workers and companies trading between the European Union and Mexico.
- The agreement can enter into force once the Council formally adopts it.
